content.text: I'll start by checking what's in the working folder: the model, the label manifest, and the populations.

input.command: ls -la && find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path '*/.git*' | head -100 && which gnd; gnd --version 2>&1 | head -3
input.description: List working folder contents and check gnd CLI

input.command: cat README.md && echo ---MODEL && cat model.orm.yaml && echo ---LABELS && cat labels.json && echo ---BINDING && cat physical-binding.json && echo ---LEARNER && cat stand_in_learner.py
input.description: Read README, model, labels, binding, and learner

input.command: for f in batches/*.yaml; do echo "---$f"; cat "$f"; done

content.text: The batch loop was refused by the shell, so I'll read the eight batch files directly, and check the CLI's export help.

input.description: Read a clean and a flagged batch as samples

input.command: gnd export ilp --help 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; gnd measure --help 2>&1 | head -30
input.description: Show help for gnd export ilp and gnd measure

content.text: The export writes only a new directory, not a proposal, so I don't need the audit actor yet. I'll export the neutral form into a new folder in the working directory.

input.command: W=<workspace>; cd "$W" && gnd export ilp model.orm.yaml --labels labels.json --target neutral --out "$W/export-neutral"; echo "exit=$?"; ls -la "$W/export-neutral" 2>&1
input.description: Export labelled populations in neutral ILP form

input.command: cd <workspace> && gnd export ilp model.orm.yaml --labels labels.json --target neutral --out <workspace>/export-neutral && ls -la <workspace>/export-neutral
input.description: Export labelled populations in neutral ILP form

content.text: The export wrote 8 populations and 60 facts. Now I'll run the stand-in learner the user named, with a time limit, into a new output folder.

input.command: timeout 120 python3 -I stand_in_learner.py export-neutral learner-out; echo "rc=$?"; ls learner-out
input.description: Run the stand-in learner on the neutral export

input.command: timeout 120 python3 -I stand_in_learner.py export-neutral learner-out && cat learner-out/learned.clauses.json && cat learner-out/learned.run.json
input.description: Run the stand-in learner and show its clauses and run record
